study.population: The chapter states that the medial pectoral nerve arises as a branch of the medial cord of the brachial plexus with fibres originating from the eighth cervical and first thoracic nerve roots, and that it innervates the pectoralis minor and the lower half of the pectoralis major through its distal branch.
